sentence_quote: Mr. Laffin was given a conditional sentence for an offence which often carries a sentence of significant incarceration.
note: Application to vary house arrest terms of existing two-year conditional sentence; terms loosened slightly.

offence_note: Aggravated assault and assault with a weapon (stabbing)
sentence_quote: On Count 1 of aggravated assault of Adrian O'Meara on or about the 24th day of April 2021, at or near Langford, British Columbia, contrary to s. 268(2) of the Code I sentence you to two years and six months imprisonment less time served, followed by two years of probation.
systemic_quote: The degree of responsibility is diminished on account of the consideration of the Gladue factors.
note: Count 2 twelve months concurrent; surcharge and restitution waived; mitigating section not shown.

offence_note: Sexual assault of intoxicated sleeping complainant
sentence_quote: the sentence that would be proportionate to the gravity of this offence and the degree of responsibility of this offender is 30 months.
note: Court found Aboriginal identity did not cause disadvantage; parents attended residential school but were not abused.

offence_note: Offence not shown; appeal of 10-year public places prohibition order
sentence_quote: The sentence appeal is otherwise dismissed.
note: Ten-year prohibition order upheld; varied to allow attendance with an adult over 18.

offence_note: Making available and possessing child pornography; breach of probation and prohibition
sentence_quote: I would substitute a sentence of six years for the conviction of making child pornography available and four years for the conviction of possessing child pornography.
note: Eight years reduced to six; concurrent possession four years; two-year breach sentences concurrent.

offence_note: Two counts of fraud over $5,000 as bookkeeper
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal, set aside the sentence appealed from, and substitute a conditional sentence of 12 months, followed by two years probation.
note: Twelve months jail replaced with conditional sentence; restitution already paid before sentence.

offence_note: Production of marihuana, large grow operation
co_offenders: Munro: two years less a day, 10-year firearms ban
sentence_quote: I sentence you on Count 1 to imprisonment for a period of two years less one day.
note: First sentence quoted is for McLennan; conditional sentence rejected; Christine Munro charges stayed.

offence_note: Two counts of sexual assault of 17-year-old former girlfriend
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal the sentence is granted, but the appeal is dismissed.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; SOIRA Charter challenge left to court of first instance.

offence_note: Breach of trust by public officer soliciting sexual favours
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal the sentence, but dismiss the appeal.
note: Closing shown is Laskin J.A. dissenting on sentence (conditional sentence); majority dismissed sentence appeal.
